**A hotfix for v0.8.0.1.** Crates whole again, glowing fireballs in bright
rooms, and barrels that stand on the floor.

**Crates and panels keep their artwork.** The real-size bricks took any
texture painted as a grid of one size for brickwork, so crates, computer
panels, metal plates and wooden planks were laid again at half size, with
their logos torn apart (E2M2's crates were the worst). Only stone walls get
real-size bricks now; the UAC crates count as wood.

**Fireballs glow in bright rooms.** With F4 Eye adaptation on, your eyes
closing down for a bright room dimmed an imp's fireball with it, so it looked
oddly dull. Effects that glow by themselves (fireballs, plasma,
puffs, explosions) now keep their own brightness, as your weapon's flash
already did.

**Barrels stand on the floor.** A soft shadow now lies under every standing
barrel, in any light, so they no longer look pasted onto the floor. Columns,
trees and other decorations now bounce light in their own colour onto what
stands around them; before, they sent none back.

## Known issue

- **Odd lighting after a mid-level change.** A light switch or similar change
  in the middle of a level can light the area oddly. Cycling through the F4
  presets fixes it.
